rfam.comment: This family represents the HIV Ribosomal frameshift signal. HIV uses a system called -1 ribosomal frameshifting to produce the required ratio of Gag and Gag-Pol polyproteins. The stem-loop structure of the frameshift signal is thought to impede the ribosome and cause slippage in the 5' direction, this causes the -1 frameshift and translation then continues in the new frame [1]. The structure of HIV Ribosomal framershift signal has been reproted in PDB: 1Z2J, 2L94, 6VWL, 6VWM and 6VWN [2, 3,4].
